basic.title: Staff Software Engineer
basic.location: Mississauga, Ontario, Canada | Remote | Hybrid within a 20-mile radius of Mississauga
basic.summary: Senior Software Engineer with over a decade building and modernizing production systems across defence intelligence, financial services and large-scale consumer infrastructure. Experienced across backend and distributed services, event-driven architectures, APIs, data and streaming pipelines, cloud infrastructure, analytical and operational front ends, AI/ML-enabled workflows, search and retrieval, security and access control, and platform reliability. Has led architecture and delivery for regulated, high-availability systems involving sensitive mission data, payments and money movement, operational telemetry at consumer scale, and large-scale platform modernization, translating complex mission and business requirements into scalable software platforms that remain reliable under production load.

experience.title: Staff Software Engineer
bullets: Build full-stack and AI capabilities across the ANVIL Platform, the shared mission-data environment Canadian defence and security organizations connect intelligence, operations and planning through, spanning All-Source Ingestion and Fusion, the Mission Ontology beneath it, and AI Enrichment.

Architected All-Source Ingestion and Fusion into scalable storage organised around the Mission Ontology, so records arriving from separate sources resolve against one configurable entity model instead of sitting as parallel copies that disagree.

Engineer the Python backend services behind the platform's analytical workflows, the REST contracts its distributed services agree on, and the PostgreSQL schemas, migrations and data contracts that hold the structured mission data underneath them.

Delivered the Mission Applications analysts work in - threat-network exploration, analytical workflow execution and real-time visualization - including the Tactical Edge interfaces that stay usable in disconnected environments.
Embedded the AI Enrichment path that annotates, classifies and links incoming records, and the search and retrieval layer over Elasticsearch that analysts query that enriched data through.

Maintain Data History and Lineage alongside attribute-based access control, so provenance and every access record are preserved as information evolves and each analyst sees only what their attributes permit.
experience.notes: Six bullets mapped onto the anchor: the ANVIL Platform and its end-to-end path, All-Source Ingestion and Fusion over the Mission Ontology, the Python/PostgreSQL backend and its data contracts, the Mission Applications and Tactical Edge front end, the AI Enrichment and Elasticsearch retrieval path, and Data History and Lineage with attribute-based access control. Written as the project universe, not a fixed stack - the writer selects per JD from inside it. Tense is mixed deliberately (Build / Architected / Engineer / Delivered / Embedded / Maintain) so the set does not read as one generated block. Stack names are limited to what the anchor notes in Experiment/projects evidence from hiring posts (Python, REST, PostgreSQL, TypeScript, React, Elasticsearch); Kafka, Redpanda, Docker and Kubernetes stay out of the bullets because they appear there only as preferred items. The capitalised system names are ANVIL's own published capability language used as proper nouns - see the anchor notes for what is verifiable and what is not.
